overview: AFL0003 (ATL0003) is a band pass filter for 865 MHz applications. It supports Indian-region ISM radio applications and is designed for low insertion loss, low pass-band ripple and high ultimate attenuation.

The filter passes 865–867 MHz with a 50 Ω impedance, a VSWR of 1.25 and a ripple of 0.2 dB. Insertion loss is 2.5 dB typical (3.0 dB maximum), and it rejects 35 dB at 862 MHz and 28 dB at 869 MHz. Power rating is 2 W.
It is housed in an IP67-rated enclosure with N-type male to N-type female connectors, weighs 630 g and operates from −30 °C to +70 °C.
